Adima – AI Photo Enhancer & Editor

Transform blurry, pixelated, low-quality, and old photos into crystal-clear HD and 4K masterpieces with Adima, the ultimate AI Photo Enhancer.

Powered by cutting-edge on-device AI technology, Adima is your all-in-one photo enhancer, AI image upscaler, and photo editor. Whether you want to restore old photos, unblur images, enhance selfies, or improve photo quality in seconds, Adima does it all natively on your phone. No cloud servers, no waiting, and 100% privacy for your memories.

POWERFUL AI PHOTO ENHANCER

Bring every shot back to life with intelligent, one-tap AI enhancement.

• Improve photo quality instantly and effortlessly
• Unblur photos and recover hidden, fine details
• Sharpen images while preserving natural skin textures
• Enhance portraits, selfies, landscapes, and everyday photography
• Fix compressed, grainy, and low-quality images
• Output natural-looking, crisp HD and 4K results

**AI IMAGE UPSCALER**

Increase image resolution without sacrificing an ounce of quality.

• Upscale low-resolution photos directly to HD, 4K and up to 8K
• Choose from flexible 1x, 2x, 4x and 8x upscaling factors
• Improve clarity while preserving exact details
• Restore pixelated and blurry images to perfection
• Maintain the correct aspect ratio during upscaling
• Prepare high-quality, sharp photos for printing or large screens


PHOTO RESTORATION 

Restore old photos and safeguard your family’s most valuable memories.

• Repair faded, scratched, and blurry vintage photos
• Recover lost facial details in classic portraits
• Give damaged and aging memories a fresh, modern look
• Digitize and restore treasured family photographs with AI

ALL-IN-ONE AI PHOTO EDITOR

Professional photo editing tools built right into the app. Edit every photo after AI enhancement without switching apps!

• Adjust Brightness, Contrast, and Saturation
• Fine-tune Sharpness, Highlights, and Shadows
• Crop, Rotate, and Flip with precision
• Seamless Before & After comparison slider

PRO AI FILTERS

Enhance every mood with professionally designed photo filters.

• Portrait, Landscape, Vintage, and Artistic filters
• Social Media-ready effects for eye-catching posts
• Create vibrant, aesthetic photos with a single tap

THREE SMART AI ENHANCEMENT MODELS

Choose the perfect AI engine for your specific image type:

• Real Model: Optimized for portraits, selfies, and human faces.
• General Model
